summary: This is a re-review. No previous findings were raised, so none remain unresolved. All changed paragraphs are accurate and well-scoped. The three subsections match the plan exactly: workflow elements (role, input, decision, record, exception), evaluation criteria, and labeled illustrative examples are present throughout. ICC Safety capability claims are consistently framed as published descriptions requiring demonstration confirmation. The ISO 45001 clause mappings (10.2, 5.4, 6.1.2) are correctly attributed to the ICC Safety page and hedged with the appropriate boundary that a mapping does not guarantee a clause is met. External reviewer access is correctly flagged as unconfirmed in the research. The Ontario JHSC guide is cited only in the FAQ subsection with an explicit caution that plants elsewhere must check their own rules. The FAQ subsection is plan-assigned and present; no FAQ content appears in the introduction or other subsections. Links use only the two supplied source URLs (icc-safety and ontario-jhsc-guide) plus the allowed internal site path /contact/. No scope boundary violations, readability problems, or problematic repetition were detected. Word count of approximately 2021 is within acceptable range of the 2000-word target. All changed paragraphs introduce no new unsupported claims.
